provider_rights_correction.reconciliation_summary: Reconciles overconfident assertions from Stage 3B-R (which labeled Tiingo Power 'FEASIBLE' and Alpaca/IBKR 'COMPLIANT'). Rights are now categorized strictly under the 5-tier institutional taxonomy based on official published legal agreements, explicitly separating API technical capability from contractual entitlements.

taxonomy_definitions.VERIFIED_BY_APPLICABLE_AGREEMENT: Expressly permitted in published standard terms without ongoing ambiguities or specialized exemptions.
taxonomy_definitions.CONDITIONAL: Permitted only under strict operational preconditions (e.g. active paid subscription, non-display declaration, platform-restricted execution, or mandatory post-termination purge).
taxonomy_definitions.UNKNOWN: Contractual terms cannot be established without inspecting an account-specific executed master service agreement or license schedule.
taxonomy_definitions.PROHIBITED_UNDER_PUBLISHED_DEFAULT_TERMS: Expressly barred under published self-service developer/starter terms; requires separate negotiated enterprise contract.
taxonomy_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: Activity or retention category is not relevant to the provider's operational role.

Tiingo.actual_customer_license_status: UNKNOWN (No active corporate subscription receipt or master service agreement verified on file)

api_technical_capability.notes: REST API returns daily EOD bars, adjusted prices, and historical splits for US equities.

authorized_non_display_research.notes: Permitted for internal quantitative modeling during active Power tier subscription ($30/mo); Starter tier limits usage to personal display.

automated_strategy_usage.notes: Permitted as internal signal input under Power tier; prohibited under Starter tier if automated generation constitutes commercial derivation.

raw_price_retention.notes: Power tier permits local caching during active subscription. Permanent retention of raw price feeds is prohibited upon subscription termination.

derived_price_feature_retention.notes: Starter tier explicitly bars persistent storage of Derived Products ('Starter Plan or Trial Plan does not permit persistent storage of Derived Products'). Power tier permits storage while active; retention post-cancellation requires perpetual rights addendum.

portfolio_weights_signals_retention.notes: Permitted in research repository provided derived weights cannot be reverse-engineered into raw vendor price ticks.

operational_logs_audit_journals.notes: Internal audit journals recording timestamp and execution decision are standard business records.

subscription_termination_rights.notes: Published terms mandate that all cached vendor data must be purged upon subscription termination. No perpetual research archive license is granted by default.

special_addenda_requirement.notes: Requires a Perpetual Research Archive Addendum if repository is to retain historical features post-subscription.

Tiingo.overconfidence_correction: Stage 3B-R claimed Tiingo Power was 'FEASIBLE'. This is corrected to CONDITIONAL: a paid subscription alone does not grant perpetual retention of research evidence after cancellation, and no active paid account has been verified.

Massive_Polygon_io.overconfidence_correction: Confirmed disqualified. Massive default terms cannot support Guardian Alpha research or prospective trading under any self-service tier.
